demo-say-hello.label: Say hello
demo-say-hello.oneSubmissionNote: This is a demonstration activity, not a qualification assessment.

preferred.label: 1 short audio introduction
preferred.instruction: Record a short audio introducing yourself in a few natural sentences.

alternatives.label: Written / text alternative
alternatives.instruction: Write the same short introduction instead if you would rather type than record audio.

capture: Keep the introduction short and natural.
Do not include private information you would not normally share.

demo-introduce-someone.label: Introduce someone
demo-introduce-someone.oneSubmissionNote: This demonstrates how Evia can capture spoken evidence involving another willing person.

preferred.label: 1 short video introduction
preferred.instruction: With their permission, record a short video introducing someone you are with.

alternatives.label: Audio alternative
alternatives.instruction: With their permission, make a short audio recording introducing them instead.

capture: Ask the person if they are happy to take part before recording.
Keep the introduction friendly and brief.
Avoid sharing private or confidential information.

demo-rock-paper-scissors.label: Rock, Paper, Scissors
demo-rock-paper-scissors.oneSubmissionNote: This demonstrates how Evia can capture a short practical activity using different visual evidence methods.

preferred.label: 1 short video — best of 3
preferred.instruction: Record a best-of-three game of rock, paper, scissors. If another person is in the video, make sure they are happy to take part.

alternatives.label: 3 photos
alternatives.instruction: Take 3 photos showing the three rounds instead of recording a video.

capture: Show enough of each round for the activity to be clear.
Keep the video short if you choose video.
Ask permission before recording another person.

demo-red-lorry.label: Red lorry, yellow lorry
demo-red-lorry.oneSubmissionNote: This is a light demonstration of Evia's audio and video evidence capture.

preferred.label: 1 audio recording
preferred.instruction: Record yourself saying 'red lorry, yellow lorry' five times in a row without going wrong.

alternatives.label: 1 video recording
alternatives.instruction: Record a video of yourself saying 'red lorry, yellow lorry' five times in a row instead.

capture: Say the phrase five times in one recording.
If you make a mistake, have another go until you are happy with it.
